semiconductor_relevance: High — Prinano Technology specializes in advanced nanoimprint lithography systems that are applicable in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Prinano Technology Co., Ltd. is an advanced nanoimprint micro-nano-manufacturing company that develops innovative nanoimprint systems and materials for various applications, including semiconductor integrated circuits. Their products, such as the PL-A and PL-SR series, offer high precision and efficiency in nanopatterning processes, making them valuable for semiconductor fabrication.
capabilities: PL-A air cushion nanoimprint system for wafers up to 300mm
High-precision inkjet printing system for residual layer control

regional_presence.China: Prinano Technology is based in Hangzhou, China, focusing on global markets for its advanced manufacturing solutions.
